record.question: Can a prospectively frozen simple BTC/ETH/SOL multi-horizon directional trend benchmark with lagged volatility targeting retain robust positive net economic value after realistic and stressed costs, drawdown/tail, turnover, concentration and robustness gates?
record.hypothesis: At least one prospectively frozen simple trend family can produce robust positive net risk-adjusted performance across BTC/ETH/SOL under lagged volatility targeting and exposure caps after complete preregistered cost and robustness treatment.
record.economic_mechanism: Persistent directional price trends may survive realistic trading frictions when captured by simple auditable lagged signals and scaled by lagged realized volatility without lookahead.
record.stopping_rule: Traverse exactly the ten program lifecycle stages in order. Stage 1 OWNER-FIRST and Stage 2 DESIGN use zero 0074 controlled scientific/history reads. DESIGN and PREREGISTRATION must prospectively freeze exact data identities, timestamp and anti-lookahead semantics, signal formulas, fast/medium/slow horizons, candidate count, lagged-volatility target, exposure caps, C0/C1/C2 costs, rebalance rules, robustness, bootstrap/DSR/PBO rules where supported, concentration/capacity and terminal gates before controlled history. NONHISTORICAL QUALIFICATION must pass at attempt 0/1 and zero controlled reads. After merged CONTROLLED BOUNDARY, ZERO-RESULT PREFLIGHT must pass. Stage 8 requires fresh explicit authorization, durable RUN_ATTEMPT.marker before the first controlled content read, and exactly one controlled development-history attempt. After marker creation, same-ID rerun, retune, rescue, threshold or horizon alteration, candidate addition, source substitution, universe expansion, history extension and recomputation are forbidden.
record.success_criteria: PASS only if valid exactly-once execution shows at least one prospectively frozen simple trend candidate passes all preregistered net economic, realistic/stressed cost, volatility-targeting, drawdown/tail, turnover, concentration and statistical robustness gates. Raw Sharpe alone cannot satisfy PASS. PASS grants research evidence only and no production/signing/order authority.
record.failure_criteria: FAIL if valid execution completes but no prospectively frozen candidate passes the required economic and robustness gates. INCONCLUSIVE is limited to prospectively defined insufficient support or mathematically undefined inference. INVALID_EXECUTION applies to identity/hash/read-count/lookahead/timestamp/candidate-count/source/persistence/exactly-once drift.
record.allowed_followup: Before attempt consumption, only semantics-preserving implementation or synthetic-qualification corrections that do not alter merged DESIGN/PREREGISTRATION science. After immutable closeout, altered signal families, horizons, cost model, volatility target, exposure cap, source set or strategy semantics require a new research ID where governance requires it.
record.forbidden_followup: No dozens-of-near-identical-window search, model-complexity contest, post-result candidate addition, source substitution, adaptive rescue, threshold relaxation, horizon alteration, cost omission, same-ID rerun/retune/rescue/recompute, or claim that DEVELOPMENT history is independent OOS. No production, signing or order-submission authority may be inferred from any 0074 outcome.
researcher_decisions: Use initial universe exactly BTC, ETH and SOL.
Bound OWNER-FIRST signal families to past-return-sign, moving-average-spread and breakout trend; exact formulas and fast/medium/slow horizons remain for later prospective freeze.
Require lagged realized-volatility targeting and explicit exposure caps with no same-bar lookahead.
Require C0 theoretical, C1 realistic and C2 stressed cost regimes; exact numerical costs remain for later prospective freeze.
Keep all candidate and trial accounting prospective; no post-result window proliferation or candidate addition.
Preserve one irreversible controlled development-history attempt with durable marker-before-read.
Require fresh explicit user authorization after Stage 7 zero-result preflight PASS before Stage 8.
Maintain production_authorized=false, signature_authorized=false and order_submission_authorized=false throughout 0074.
record.production_relevance: Research-only simple multi-horizon directional trend benchmark. Any PASS may inform later separately governed work only after immutable closeout; no automatic production, signature or order authority.
notes: Stage 1 OWNER-FIRST freezes identity and family scope before any 0074 controlled scientific/history read.
0073 remains immutable INCONCLUSIVE and contributes no result-informed parameter selection to 0074.
Exact horizons, formulas, candidate count and numerical gates remain for DESIGN/PREREGISTRATION.
Controlled reads 0, scientific engine 0, source-network fetches 0 and attempt 0/1 at OWNER-FIRST.
